metadata.title: Volume Growth of Self-Shrinkers of the $Q_k$-Flow in $\mathbb{R}^{n+1}$
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we establish a general volume estimate for complete Riemannian manifolds under suitable differential inequalities involving a proper function and a symmetric tensor, without imposing curvature assumptions. As an application, we prove that a class of orientable hypersurfaces properly immersed in Euclidean space has at most polynomial volume growth and finite weighted volume. This class includes, in particular, certain self-shrinkers of the $Q_k$-flow and properly immersed minimal hypersurfaces for which the normal component of the position vector is bounded.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: Q_k 流自缩子的体积增长
analysis.workSummary: 从适当函数与对称张量的微分不等式推导无曲率假设的体积估计，并应用到部分 Q_k 流自缩子与适当浸入极小超曲面。
analysis.breakthrough: 将多项式体积增长和有限加权体积纳入统一判据。
analysis.limitations: 应用只覆盖满足给定条件的自缩子；极小超曲面还要求位置向量法向分量有界。
analysis.priorityReason: 将多项式体积增长和有限加权体积纳入统一判据。
